title: SceneTeract: Agentic Functional Affordances and VLM Grounding in 3D Scenes
summary: A 3D-scene framework that grounds functional affordances and explicitly evaluates navigability, reachability, interactability, clearance, and visibility for an embodied agent.

mechanisms.name: Agent-conditioned functional verification
mechanisms.description: Conditions affordance validity on the agent and checks physical predicates such as visibility, reachability, interactability, navigability, and clearance.
mechanisms.limitations: A 3D agent model and VLM grounding can diverge from real users and phone sensing; predicate satisfaction is not an outcome receipt.
